__broaden__.γένηται: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a conditional clause after εἴ ποτε: ’if there ever comes to be’ · also in an indefinite relative clause with κε: ’proves, turns out’ (κρείσσων γένηται ’proves the stronger’) · also after ὅπως in an indirect question: ’how … may come about, turn out’ · also in a prohibition or negative wish after μή: ’let it not become’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a temporal clause after ἐπήν: ’has come to be’ (ἐπὴν τὰ πρῶτα γένηται ’once he has been born’) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a fear clause after δείδω μή: ’lest … come to be’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that … may come about’
__broaden__.γῆρας: γῆρας — old age; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., after ἐς: ’(into) old age’
__broaden__.εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; potential with κεν: ’it would be’ · also in a wish after εἴθε: ’would that it were’ · also in a wish or a request: ’let there be’ (εἴη ὃς … ’let there be one who …’) · also in a relative clause: ’were, should be’ (ὅς τις … εἴη ’whoever should be’)
__broaden__.κακόν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. sg. used as a noun in apposition to a person: ’an evil, a bane’ (τυκτὸν κακόν ’a fashioned evil’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. agreeing with θυμόν: ’evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’an evil thing’ (ἦλθε κακόν ’evil came’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. agreeing with πόλεμον: ’evil’ (πόλεμον κακόν ’evil war’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun, object of an infinitive: ’evil’ (φυγέειν κακόν ’to flee evil’)

__broaden__.μάχην: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg., object of καταδύμεναι: ’the fighting’ · also fem. acc. sg., after ἀνά (ἄν τε μάχην): ’through the fighting’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἐτάνυσσε: ’the fighting’ (μάχην ἐτάνυσσε ’stretched the battle’) · also fem. acc. sg., cognate object of ἐμάχοντο: ’fight’ (μάχην ἐμάχοντο ’fought the fight’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ὄτρυνον: ’the fighting’ · also fem. acc. sg., with ἐς following it: ’into the battle’ (μάχην ἐς κυδιάνειραν ’into the man-glorifying battle’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἤγειρας: ’the battle’ (μάχην ἤγειρας ’you stirred up the battle’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἔχουσι: ’the fight’ (μάχην … ἔχουσι ’keep up the fight’)
__broaden__.μεθ: μετά (elided μεθ’ before a rough breathing) — among, with; prep. + dat.: ’among’ · also prep. + acc., ’after, in quest of’ (μεθ’ ὕλην ’for wood’) · also prep. + acc., ’among, into the midst of’ (μεθ’ ὅμιλον ’among the throng’)
__broaden__.μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’) · also μὴ μέν + fut. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … not’ (μὴ μὲν … ἐποχήσεται ’that no other man will ride’) · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also the negative of an infinitive in a reported threat: ’not to’ (μὴ πρίν … ἀπονέεσθαι ’not to go back until’)
__broaden__.μῆτιν: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, counsel; fem. acc. sg., of respect: ’in counsel’ · also fem. acc. sg., direct object of ὑφαίνειν: ’a plan’ · also object of ἐνίψει: ’cunning’ (νόον καὶ μῆτιν ’mind and cunning’) · also object of τεκτήναιτο: ’(frame) cunning’ · also fem. acc. sg. with διά: ’through the counsel (of)’ (διὰ μῆτιν Ἀθήνης ’through Athena’s counsel’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἐνίσποι: ’a plan, counsel’
